interpretation: One NR4A3-rearranged EMC case progressed despite five cycles of doxorubicin/ifosfamide. Four tumor samples collected across sites and treatment time points differed in reported EGFR/MET copy gains and FBXW7 variants; all were microsatellite-stable, low-TMB and PD-L1-negative. EGFR, MET and mTOR therapies were proposed but not administered or functionally tested. Table 1 labels both FBXW7 variants as missense, although the reported notation describes a splice-site variant and a stop variant; this annotation discrepancy remains unresolved. MET gain in this separate patient does not establish why the cabozantinib-trial responder benefited. These findings caution against assuming one biopsy represents every lesion or treatment time point.
source_limitations: Prior chemotherapy and sampling time confound progression mechanisms. No targeted drug administered.
Table1 source labels FBXW7 c.585-2A>T and c.1637C>A p.S546* as missense; no functional reannotation validated here.
Figure1 onset2015 and resection2019 do not match narrative six-year preoperative history.
